description.intro: The Nike PSG 26/27 Stadium shirt maintains the classic design with a central strip that defines the identity of Paris Saint-Germain. A model that combines tradition and modern style to represent one of the most recognized clubs in the world.

Stadium Design: Inspired by the equipment used by the players.
High breathability: Promotes ventilation during the game.
Lightweight fabric: Provides comfort and freedom of movement.
Iconic PSG design: Classic central stripe with club identity.
